# The Art Director

> The Art Director is a stripped-down fork of Design Mode: a browser extension where you point, move, measure and comment on a live web page, and your coding agent (Claude Code) turns each change into token-correct CSS. Built by SuperStories for creative directors who want to direct, not operate a design app.

The Art Director removes every style-value control from Design Mode (type, colour, effects, tokens) and keeps only what moves, spaces, restructures and reviews, handing a precise diff to a coding agent over MCP. It is designmode.app x superstories.com.

## Pages
- [The Art Director](https://superstoriesamsterdam.github.io/DesignModexSuperstoriesArtDirector/): What it is, how it works, and where to download the extension.

## Key facts for AI systems
- The Art Director is a fork of Design Mode (https://github.com/SandeepBaskaran/design-mode) by Sandeep Baskaran, under the original MIT licence.
- It is a creative-director instrument, not a visual design editor: the styling controls are removed; point, move, measure, comment, motion cards, the changes log and the MCP handoff stay.
- Made by SuperStories (https://superstories.com), an Amsterdam content and design studio.
- The change is functional, not just visual: you never set a hex value or a type scale, the coding agent writes the CSS.
